values.tailo: Khí-puânn ài phah-khui tsiah ē-tàng sú-iōng
values.poj: Khí-pôaⁿ ài phah-khui chiah ē-tàng sú-iōng

values.ja: キーボードを有効にして使い始めましょう

typingGuide.comment: Home section header above the typing-guide feature list.

newFeatures.comment: Home section header above the feature-settings list.

setupGuide.comment: Setup-guide navigation row label + sub-page title.

setupGuideDescription.comment: Setup-guide intro paragraph: third-party keyboards must be enabled manually.

values.hanji: 手機仔系統規定第三方齒盤愛手動啟用才會當使用，請照下跤 ê 說明完成設定。
values.tailo: Tshiú-ki-á hē-thóng kui-tīng tē-sann hong khí-puânn ài tshiú-tōng khé-iōng tsiah ē-tàng sú-iōng, tshiánn tsiàu ē-kha ê suat-bîng uân-sîng siat-tīng.
values.poj: Chhiú-ki-á hē-thóng kui-tēng tē-saⁿ hong khí-pôaⁿ ài chhiú-tōng khé-iōng chiah ē-tàng sú-iōng, chhiáⁿ chiàu ē-kha ê soat-bêng oân-sêng siat-tēng.
values.en: Your phone requires third-party keyboards to be enabled manually. Follow the steps below to finish setup.
values.ja: スマートフォンの仕様上、サードパーティ製キーボードは手動で有効にする必要があります。下記の手順に従って設定を完了してください。

setupInfoMessage.comment: Setup-guide note explaining that 'Allow Full Access' permits app/keyboard data sharing and stating the network privacy policy.

values.hanji: 「允准完整取用」予齒盤會當佮 App 共用設定佮使用資料。台語齒盤袂共你拍 ê 內容送去網路。
values.tailo: "Ún-tsún uân-tsíng tshú-iōng" hōo khí-puânn ē-tàng kah App kiōng-iōng siat-tīng kah sú-iōng tsu-liāu. Tâi-gí khí-puânn buē kā lí phah ê luē-iông sàng khì bāng-lōo.
values.poj: "Ún-chún oân-chéng chhú-iōng" hō͘ khí-pôaⁿ ē-tàng kah App kiōng-iōng siat-tēng kah sú-iōng chu-liāu. Tâi-gí khí-pôaⁿ bōe kā lí phah ê lōe-iông sàng khì bāng-lō͘.
values.en: "Allow Full Access" lets the keyboard share settings and usage data with the app. TaigiKeyboard does not send what you type over the network.
values.ja: 「フルアクセスを許可」すると、キーボードとアプリで設定や利用データを共有できます。台語キーボードは入力内容をネットワークへ送信しません。

setupBrandWarning.comment: Setup-guide note: steps may differ slightly across phone brands.

values.hanji: 無仝牌子 ê 手機仔，設定 ê 方式可能會淡薄仔無仝款，毋過方式應該攏差不多。
values.tailo: Bô kâng pâi-tsú ê tshiú-ki-á, siat-tīng ê hong-sik khó-lîng huē tām-po̍h-á bô-kāng-khuán, m̄-koh hong-sik ìng-kai láng tsha-put-to.
values.poj: Bô kâng pâi-chú ê chhiú-ki-á, siat-tēng ê hong-sek khó-lêng hōe tām-po̍h-á bô-kāng-khoán, m̄-koh hong-sek èng-kai láng chha-put-to.
values.en: Steps may differ slightly between phone brands, but the overall process is much the same.
values.ja: スマートフォンのメーカーによって設定方法が少し異なる場合がありますが、大まかな流れはほぼ同じです。

setupGuideCompletedMessage.comment: Setup-guide full-screen closing paragraph: restart the app and switch via the globe key.

values.hanji: 完成了後，重開你目前使用 ê App。紲落來，佇會當拍字 ê 所在揤牢地球圖示，切去台語齒盤。
values.tailo: Uân-sîng liáu-āu, tîng-khui lí ba̍k-tsîng sú-iōng ê App. Suà--lo̍h-lâi, tī ē-tàng phah-jī ê sóo-tsāi tshi̍h tiâu tuē-kiû tôo-sī, tshiat khì tâi-gí khí-puânn.
values.poj: Oân-sêng liáu-āu, têng-khui lí ba̍k-chêng sú-iōng ê App. Sòa--lo̍h-lâi, tī ē-tàng phah-jī ê só͘-chāi chhi̍h tiâu tōe-kiû tô͘-sī, chhiat khì tâi-gí khí-pôaⁿ.
values.en: Once done, restart the app you are using. Then, wherever you can type, press and hold the globe icon to switch to TaigiKeyboard.
values.ja: 完了したら、使用中のアプリを再起動してください。その後、文字を入力できる場所で地球儀アイコンを長押しして、台湾語キーボードに切り替えます。

setupGuideGoToSettings.comment: Setup-guide button: open the system input-method settings page.

setupGuideStep2AddKeyboard.comment: Setup-guide step 2 title: tap 'Add keyboard' and 'Allow Full Access'.

values.hanji: 點揤「增加齒盤」、「允准完整取用」
values.ja: 「キーボードを追加」「フルアクセスを許可」をタップ

rateUs.comment: Home resource link: rate the app on the store.

aboutKeyboard.comment: About page title and the row that opens it: the mobile Home resource link; on desktop the input-source menu row and settings window title (no sidebar row).

aboutIntroProject.comment: About page (all platforms), first line: what the project is. Two short paragraphs in all (USER 2026-09-20: "the description text is too much and too long"). Hanji authored by the USER 2026-09-20 (revised same day: paid-features + education-groups lines); tailo / poj generated 2026-09-20.

values.hanji: 台語齒盤是一个自由、開源 ê 台語拍字家私，永遠免費、無廣告，嘛袂推出付費功能。毋管是一般使用者、先生、學校抑是台語教育團體，攏會當自由使用。希望予逐家用台語、教台語 ê 時，免有額外 ê 負擔。
values.tailo: Tâi-gí Khí-puânn sī tsi̍t ê tsū-iû, khai-guân ê Tâi-gí phah-jī ke-si, íng-uán bián-huì, bô kóng-kò, mā bē tshui-tshut hù-huì kong-lîng. M̄-kuán sī it-puann sú-iōng-tsiá, sian-sinn, ha̍k-hāu ia̍h-sī Tâi-gí kàu-io̍k thuân-thé, lóng ē-tàng tsū-iû sú-iōng. Hi-bāng hōo ta̍k-ke iōng Tâi-gí, kà Tâi-gí ê sî, bián ū gia̍h-guā ê hū-tam.
values.poj: Tâi-gí Khí-pôaⁿ sī chi̍t ê chū-iû, khai-goân ê Tâi-gí phah-jī ke-si, éng-oán bián-hùi, bô kóng-kò, mā bē chhui-chhut hù-hùi kong-lêng. M̄-koán sī it-poaⁿ sú-iōng-chiá, sian-siⁿ, ha̍k-hāu ia̍h-sī Tâi-gí kàu-io̍k thoân-thé, lóng ē-tàng chū-iû sú-iōng. Hi-bāng hō͘ ta̍k-ke iōng Tâi-gí, kà Tâi-gí ê sî, bián ū gia̍h-gōa ê hū-tam.
values.en: TaigiKeyboard is a free, open-source Taiwanese input method — free forever, with no ads and no paid features ever. Everyday users, teachers, schools and Taiwanese-language education groups are all free to use it. The hope is that using and teaching Taiwanese comes with no extra burden.
values.ja: 台語齒盤は、自由でオープンソースの台湾語入力ツールです。ずっと無料で、広告もなく、有料機能を出すこともありません。一般の利用者、先生、学校、台湾語教育団体のどなたでも自由に使えます。台湾語を使うとき、教えるときに、余計な負担がないことを願っています。

aboutIntroMaintainer.comment: About page (all platforms), second line: one maintainer, the hope. Hanji authored by the USER 2026-09-20 (revised same day: paid-features + education-groups lines); tailo / poj generated 2026-09-20.

values.hanji: 這个計畫目前由我一个人利用上班以外 ê 時間開發佮維護。向望會當一直做落去，予逐个想欲用母語拍字 ê 人，攏會當輕鬆用母語拍字。
values.tailo: Tsit ê kè-uē bo̍k-tsiân iû guá tsi̍t ê lâng lī-iōng siōng-pan í-guā ê sî-kan khai-huat kah uî-hōo. Ǹg-bāng ē-tàng it-ti̍t tsò lo̍h-khì, hōo ta̍k ê siūnn-beh iōng bó-gí phah-jī ê lâng, lóng ē-tàng khin-sang iōng bó-gí phah-jī.
values.poj: Chit ê kè-ōe bo̍k-chiân iû goá chi̍t ê lâng lī-iōng siōng-pan í-gōa ê sî-kan khai-hoat kah ûi-hō͘. Ǹg-bāng ē-tàng it-ti̍t chò lo̍h-khì, hō͘ ta̍k ê siūⁿ-beh iōng bó-gí phah-jī ê lâng, lóng ē-tàng khin-sang iōng bó-gí phah-jī.
values.en: This project is developed and maintained by one person, in the hours outside a day job. I hope to keep it going, so that everyone who wants to type in their mother tongue can do so with ease.
values.ja: このプロジェクトは現在、私一人が本業以外の時間で開発と保守を行っています。これからも続けていき、母語で入力したいすべての人が、気軽に母語で入力できることを願っています。
